lifecycle_classes.PERMANENT_OPERATIONAL: No automated deletion, ever, regardless of disk pressure. Watchtower/3SW2 canonical state and any store whose name matches a Watchtower/3SW2 marker is structurally forced into this class (src/ops/storage_lifecycle_policy.py classify_store()).
lifecycle_classes.PERMANENT_EVIDENCE_INDEX: No automated deletion. Signatures/digests/compact indexes required to reproduce a human decision or verify evidence.
lifecycle_classes.HOT_REPLAYABLE: Retain a bounded recent period/size; older data may migrate to COLD_REPLAYABLE.
lifecycle_classes.COLD_REPLAYABLE: Archive/compact according to policy; not immediately reclaimable but not permanently protected either.
lifecycle_classes.COMPACTABLE: Structure/format can shrink (e.g. VACUUM-equivalent, or closed-segment compaction) without losing informational content.
lifecycle_classes.REGENERABLE: Can be recreated by re-running a known script/pipeline; safe to retire if disk-pressure demands it AFTER confirming no live consumer.
lifecycle_classes.TEMPORARY: Short TTL; abandoned .tmp.* files, process-lifetime scratch state.
lifecycle_classes.RETIREMENT_ELIGIBLE: Proven (via consumer trace) to have zero live readers; eligible for deletion only after the proof is recorded, never on age alone.
lifecycle_classes.UNKNOWN_NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW: No automated deletion until classified by a human.
